name: Modern sequencer styles
description: Five loops in the style of present-day sequencer songs, written from each song's tempo, key and chord progression: drums, a bass line on the chord roots, and a chord or arpeggio part. They are style sketches, not transcriptions: the signature melodies and hooks are left out on purpose, and nothing here was measured against the recordings (tempo, key and chords are from memory). Start a song row (blinding, levitating, badguy, getlucky, uptown); its tempo token sets the bank tempo. m10 drums, m13 bass, m14 guitar, m15 keys, m16 pad, m11 arpeggio.
prompt: banks of sequencer songs in MPL; prompts that create MPL sequences that match modern-day sequencer songs
